title: A Demonstration of Brilliance in Four Acts
description: Four storylines are intertwined in this ode to absurdity that begins with the birth of an adult man in a suit. He is acclaimed by the people who are waiting for someone special, but at the first mistake they turn their backs on him.
music: until the moment a fly causes a bug in the system. The universe collapses
bras are overrated and the stars twinkle!
